property_summary: For any non-empty _tos list and any callee address, the reference contract either reverts if any low-level transferFrom call fails, or returns true only when all calls succeed; the mutant always returns true even if a callee call fails — so there exists inputs (a failing callee and a non-empty _tos) where the mutant returns true but the reference reverts (observable via try/catch).
change_summary: Ignore call success entirely and always return true even if calls failed (remove require), changing behavior when original would revert on failures to now return true.
